verdict.rationale: LobeChat documents a public REST API, an OpenAPI-generated SDK and a CLI, all of which mention authentication. Nothing in the evidence shows issuing API keys or tokens to an agent, let alone scoping them or limiting them to least privilege. Generic API authentication and SSO login providers are adjacent features and do not establish scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
